title: item source id registry gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求 item source.source_id 引用已登记 source id。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh source_id registry check; /tmp unregistered-source-id fixture reports items:migrated-pcr02-docs-copyfirst-001 source_id not registered: ghost-source
risk: 只检查 source id 登记，不访问外部源文件。

title: item source manifest path gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求 item source.source_manifest 是相对本地存在路径。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh source_manifest path check; /tmp missing-migration-manifest fixture reports items:migrated-pcr02-docs-copyfirst-001 source_manifest missing: artifacts/manifests/missing-migration.jsonl
risk: 只检查 manifest 路径存在，不复核迁移内容完整性。

title: item source and artifact identity gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求 source_sha256 和 artifact-ref sha256 为小写 64 位 hex，artifact-ref size 为正整数。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh SHA256_RE and artifact size check; /tmp invalid-source-sha fixture reports invalid source_sha256; /tmp invalid-artifact-size fixture reports invalid artifact size
risk: 只检查格式和类型，不重新计算 hash。
